name: bahira-website
description: The website of Bahira Foundation, Bahawalpur: English, Urdu and Saraiki.

scripts.dev: node scripts/sync-brand.mjs && node scripts/build-images.mjs && next dev
scripts.build: node scripts/sync-brand.mjs && node scripts/build-images.mjs && node scripts/check-content.mjs && next build && node scripts/check-site.mjs
scripts.build:release: node scripts/sync-brand.mjs && node scripts/build-images.mjs && node scripts/check-content.mjs --release && next build && node scripts/check-site.mjs
